verdict.rationale: Omnara has no documented repo-level conventions file, such as an AGENTS.md-style context file read automatically from the codebase. It does let developers package reusable instructions and supporting files as Skills, define agents in a YAML config, and attach documents to a conversation. Any of these could carry codebase conventions to agents. Missing for 10: an explicit codebase context or conventions file mechanism, evidence that such context shapes plans and code generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
